description: Admin pages: dashboard home (stats + recent trips), shared TripForm component, trips management table with search/pagination/delete, new trip page, edit trip page, and bookings overview. Depends on FEAT-001 (admin-api.ts and admin layout must exist first).
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/admin/page.tsx — dashboard home. 'use client'. Imports: useQuery from '@tanstack/react-query', useQueryClient, useRouter from 'next/navigation', Link from 'next/link', adminGetStats from '@/lib/admin-api', adminDeleteTrip from '@/lib/admin-api', useTrips from '@/hooks/useTrips', Modal from '@/components/ui/Modal', Button from '@/components/ui/Button', LoadingSpinner from '@/components/ui/LoadingSpinner', Badge from '@/components/ui/Badge', formatCurrency, formatDate from '@/lib/utils'. Stats row: useQuery({ queryKey: ['admin','stats'], queryFn: adminGetStats }). Show 4 stat cards in a grid-cols-4 responsive row (grid-cols-2 on mobile): Total Trips (MapPin icon), Active Trips (CheckCircle icon), Total Bookings (Briefcase icon), Total Revenue (formatCurrency). Loading: show 4 gray animate-pulse rounded-xl h-24 divs. Recent trips: useTrips({ limit: 5, page: 1 }). Table with columns: Title, Destination, Price (formatCurrency), Available Seats, Status (Badge — Active/Inactive based on isActive), Actions (Edit button → router.push('/admin/trips/'+trip._id+'/edit'), Delete button opens confirm modal). Confirm modal: Modal size='sm', title='Deactivate Trip', body text 'This will soft-delete the trip and make it invisible to users.', buttons Keep + Confirm Deactivate. On confirm: adminDeleteTrip(tripId) then queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['trips'] }). Quick actions row: two cards, 'Add New Trip' and 'View All Bookings'.

Create apps/web/src/components/admin/TripForm.tsx — reusable trip form. 'use client'. Zod schema tripFormSchema with fields: title (string min 3), slug (string min 3, optional — auto-generated from title client-side using title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-') if empty), destination (string min 1), country (string default 'India'), description (string min 20), shortDescription (string min 10), category (z.enum(['Adventure','Beach','Cultural','Wildlife','City','Mountain','Budget'])), duration (z.coerce.number().min(1)), nights (z.coerce.number().min(0)), maxGroupSize (z.coerce.number().min(1)), pricePerPerson (z.coerce.number().min(1)), discountPrice (z.coerce.number().optional()), availableSeats (z.coerce.number().min(0)), difficulty (z.enum(['Easy','Moderate','Challenging'])), coverImage (string url), inclusions (string — textarea), exclusions (string — textarea), highlights (string — textarea), cancellationPolicy (string min 5), isActive (boolean default true), isFeatured (boolean default false), startDates (string — comma-separated). Props: defaultValues?: Partial<ITrip>, onSubmit: (data: TripFormData) => Promise<void>, isSubmitting: boolean, submitLabel: string. In onSubmit handler: split inclusions/exclusions/highlights by newline filter empty, split startDates by comma filter empty, call props.onSubmit with spread data + arrays. defaultValues conversion: join arrays with newlines/commas. Use useForm with zodResolver. Two-column grid for: title+slug, destination+country, duration+nights, maxGroupSize+availableSeats, pricePerPerson+discountPrice. Full-width for: category+difficulty (selects using <select> with same Input classes), description, shortDescription, coverImage, inclusions, exclusions, highlights, cancellationPolicy, startDates. Bottom row: isActive checkbox + isFeatured checkbox + Submit Button. Textarea style class: 'w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF6B00] focus:border-transparent resize-y min-h-[80px]'. Select style class: same as input. serverError prop: string | undefined — show red banner above form.

Create apps/web/src/app/admin/trips/page.tsx — trips management table. 'use client'. Imports: useState, useEffect, useQueryClient from react/@tanstack/react-query, useTrips from '@/hooks/useTrips', adminDeleteTrip, adminUpdateTrip from '@/lib/admin-api', Link from 'next/link', Modal/Button/Pagination/Badge/LoadingSpinner/EmptyState from '@/components/ui/', formatCurrency from '@/lib/utils'. State: page=1, search='', deleteId=null|string. Debounced search: useEffect with 300ms setTimeout, on change reset page to 1. Fetch: useTrips({ search, page, limit: 10 }). Table: sticky header bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm. Columns: (40px) Cover image , Title (font-medium), Destination, Category, Price (formatCurrency), Duration (N days), Seats, Active (toggle button: if isActive show green dot + 'Active', else gray + 'Inactive'; onClick calls adminUpdateTrip(trip._id, { isActive: !trip.isActive }) then invalidate ['trips']), Edit (Link to /admin/trips/trip._id/edit, secondary Button sm), Delete (danger Button sm opens modal). Loading: LoadingSpinner. Empty: EmptyState icon='🗺️' title='No trips found'. Confirm delete modal: size='sm', soft-delete language. After delete: invalidate ['trips'].

Create apps/web/src/app/admin/trips/new/page.tsx — add new trip page. 'use client'. Imports: useState, useRouter, adminCreateTrip from '@/lib/admin-api', TripForm from '@/components/admin/TripForm'. State: isSubmitting=false, serverError=''. Handler: async (data) => { setIsSubmitting(true); try { await adminCreateTrip(data); router.push('/admin/trips'); } catch(e) { setServerError(extractErrorMessage(e)); } finally { setIsSubmitting(false); } }. Page layout: <div className='p-6 md:p-8'>, header row with back link '← Trips' + h1 'Add New Trip'. Render <TripForm onSubmit={handler} isSubmitting={isSubmitting} serverError={serverError} submitLabel='Create Trip' />.

Create apps/web/src/app/admin/trips/[id]/edit/page.tsx — edit trip page. 'use client'. Route param: params.id is the trip _id. Strategy: useTrips({ limit: 200 }) to fetch all trips, then find trip where t._id === params.id (public API only supports slug lookup, so we fetch the list and find by _id client-side; 200 is safe for an admin). Imports: same as new page + useTrips, EmptyState, LoadingSpinner. State: isSubmitting, serverError. While loading: <LoadingSpinner fullPage />. If not found: <EmptyState icon='🔍' title='Trip not found' action={{ label: 'Back to Trips', onClick: () => router.push('/admin/trips') }} />. Handler: async (data) => { await adminUpdateTrip(params.id, data); router.push('/admin/trips'); }. Render <TripForm defaultValues={trip} onSubmit={handler} isSubmitting={isSubmitting} serverError={serverError} submitLabel='Save Changes' />.

Create apps/web/src/app/admin/bookings/page.tsx — bookings overview. 'use client'. State: page=1, tab='All' (All|Pending|Confirmed|Cancelled). Data: useQuery({ queryKey: ['admin','bookings',page], queryFn: () => adminGetAllBookings({ page, limit: 15 }), retry: false }). On error (API doesn't exist): show fallback banner 'Showing your own bookings only — admin bookings endpoint not available' and use useMyBookings(page) instead. Tabs: All|Pending|Confirmed|Cancelled (client-side filter). Table columns: Booking Ref (font-mono text-xs), Contact Email, Trip title (from tripSnapshot.title), Departure (formatDate), Travellers count, Total (formatCurrency), Status (<Badge status={b.status}>), Payment (<Badge status={b.paymentStatus}>), Created (formatDate). Pagination: <Pagination>. Empty: <EmptyState icon='📋' title='No bookings found' />. Loading: <LoadingSpinner />.
acceptance_criteria: apps/web/src/app/admin/page.tsx renders stat cards and recent trips table without runtime errors
apps/web/src/components/admin/TripForm.tsx exports a form component with Zod validation and handles array fields (inclusions, exclusions, highlights, startDates) via textarea/comma-split
apps/web/src/app/admin/trips/page.tsx renders a searchable, paginated trips table with edit/delete/active-toggle actions
apps/web/src/app/admin/trips/new/page.tsx renders TripForm and calls adminCreateTrip on submit
apps/web/src/app/admin/trips/[id]/edit/page.tsx pre-fills TripForm with existing trip data and calls adminUpdateTrip on submit
apps/web/src/app/admin/bookings/page.tsx renders a tabbed bookings table with graceful fallback if admin endpoint is unavailable
Running `cd apps/web && npm run build` completes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: cd apps/web && npm run build — must complete with exit code 0 and no TypeScript errors in the output
findings: All 6 files created and build passes (exit 0, zero TS errors). admin/page.tsx: stat cards + recent trips table + delete modal + quick actions. TripForm.tsx: Zod schema, RHF, array field textarea/CSV split, auto-slug, server error banner. trips/page.tsx: search debounce, active toggle, paginated table, delete modal. trips/new/page.tsx: create flow. trips/[id]/edit/page.tsx: list-and-find-by-_id strategy. bookings/page.tsx: admin endpoint with graceful fallback to useMyBookings + tab filter.
